text: Lets you configure infrastructure behavior via composable function pipelines instead of writing custom controllers
quote: With Crossplane you don’t have to write a controller. Instead you configure a pipeline of functions.

text: Functions can be authored in multiple languages including YAML, KCL, Python, and Go
quote: Functions allow you to write your configuration in multiple languages, including YAML, KCL, Python, and Go.

text: Managed resources extend Kubernetes to manage external/cloud resources such as AWS RDS instances
quote: there’s an RDS instance MR that extends Kubernetes with the ability to manage AWS RDS instances.

text: Installs via a Helm chart
quote: Install Crossplane using the Helm chart.

text: Supports enabling real-time compositions via a feature flag
quote: Enable support for real time compositions.

text: Can automatically protect Providers from deletion while they have active managed resources
quote: Enable automatic protection of Providers from deletion when they have active managed resources.

text: Composition Functions can be tested and rendered standalone without needing a live Kubernetes cluster
quote: testing and rendering standalone Composition Functions without the need to access a Kubernetes cluster running Crossplane

text: Provides tooling for troubleshooting Compositions, Composite Resources, and Managed Resources
quote: troubleshooting Crossplane Compositions, Composite Resources and Managed Resources

text: Supports building, installing, updating, and pushing Crossplane Packages
quote: building, installing, updating and pushing Crossplane Packages

text: Providers connect Crossplane to external APIs, giving broad provider coverage
quote: Providers - Providers connect Crossplane to external APIs

text: Configurations are portable packages of Crossplane resources that can be shared
quote: Configurations - Portable packages of Crossplane resources

text: Image Configs give centralized control over package image configuration
quote: Image Configs - Centralized control of package image configuration

text: Composite Resource Definitions let you define schemas for composite resources (custom APIs)
quote: Composite Resource Definitions - Define schemas for composite resources

text: Environment Configs act as in-memory data stores usable within Compositions
quote: Environment Configs - In-memory data stores for Compositions

text: Composition Revisions let you manage and track changes to Compositions over time
quote: Composition Revisions - Manage changes to Compositions with revisions

text: Exposes declarative APIs that humans, automation, and AI systems can safely act on
quote: Expose declarative APIs that humans, automation, and AI systems can safely act on

text: Extends Kubernetes' RBAC and reliability features to orchestrate more than just containers
quote: extending its battle hardened reliability and security features like Role Based Access Control (RBAC) to orchestrate everything - not just containers.

text: Automatically corrects drift when software state diverges from desired state
quote: If your software ever drifts from your desired state, the control plane automatically corrects the drift.

text: New features are introduced behind alpha feature flags, off by default
quote: Crossplane introduces new features behind feature flags. By default alpha features are off.

text: Extends Kubernetes to manage any resource anywhere, not just containers
quote: Extend Kubernetes to manage any resource anywhere

text: Lets you design custom APIs and abstractions for how users interact with your control plane
quote: It lets you design the APIs and abstractions that your users use to interact with your control planes.

text: Installing Crossplane enables installation of Provider, Function, and Configuration package resources
quote: Installing Crossplane enables the installation of Crossplane Provider, Function, and Configuration resources.

text: Ships a broad set of pre-built managed resources covering common cloud needs
quote: There’s already a Crossplane managed resource for that.

text: Real-time compositions can be enabled via the --enable-realtime-compositions flag
quote: `--enable-realtime-compositions` Enable support for real time compositions.

text: Pre-release versions can be installed from the master Helm channel
quote: Install pre-release versions of Crossplane from the master Crossplane Helm channel.

text: Functions extend Crossplane with new ways to configure composition logic
quote: Functions - Functions extend Crossplane with new ways to configure composition

text: Provides a library of reusable components to assemble a platform faster
quote: Use a library of components to assemble your platform faster
